name: one-byok
description: Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API provider to GitHub Copilot. Configure a Base URL and API Key, and One-BYOK discovers available models automatically and detects vision capabilities per model.

oneByok.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (should end with /v1). Models are fetched from <baseUrl>/models.

oneByok.apiKey.markdownDescription: Plaintext fallback for the API key. Prefer the command **One-BYOK: Set API Key**, which stores the key in VS Code secret storage.

oneByok.maxInputTokens.description: Reported max input tokens for discovered models.

oneByok.maxOutputTokens.description: Reported max output tokens for discovered models.

oneByok.enableTools.description: Advertise tool-calling capability (needed for Copilot agent mode) and pass tools through to the endpoint.

oneByok.enableVision.description: Advertise vision / image input capability for models that support it and pass image attachments through to the endpoint.

oneByok.forceVision.markdownDescription: Advertise image input for **every** model, even those the endpoint reports as non-vision. Only enable this when your endpoint/proxy automatically routes image requests to a vision-capable upstream model (e.g. a gateway that silently falls back). With a strict endpoint this will surface HTTP 400 errors when an image is attached to a non-vision model.

oneByok.injectWorkspaceContext.markdownDescription: Automatically inject workspace context (active files, git info, open tabs) into system prompts. Enables models to understand your project structure and provide more relevant responses. Disabled by default for local models with smaller context windows.

oneByok.debugLogging.markdownDescription: Raise the **One-BYOK** output channel to **Debug** level, adding verbose traces (request bodies, SSE chunks, tool calls and results, image conversion). Disabled by default: traces may contain prompt and response content. You can also change the level from the Output panel dropdown.

oneByok.maxWorkspaceContextChars.markdownDescription: Maximum characters for workspace context injected into prompts. Lower this for small local models (8B and below) to avoid overwhelming them.

oneByok.requestTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Request timeout in milliseconds for chat completions. If the model does not respond within this time, the request is cancelled. Default: 300000 (5 minutes).

oneByok.endpoints.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (each `{ baseUrl, apiKey, name? }`). Use the command **One-BYOK: Add Endpoint** to add endpoints; they are stored here and persist across workspaces. An optional `name` labels the endpoint in the model picker (falls back to the URL host).

oneByok.maxRetries.markdownDescription: How many times to retry the **selected** model when the request fails for a transient reason (network error, DNS failure, timeout, HTTP 429/500/502/503/504). Default `2`. Set to `0` to disable retrying. Auth errors (401/403) and bad requests (400/404) are never retried — only model failures that may pass on a second try.

oneByok.fallbackModels.markdownDescription: Ordered list of backup model ids to try, in order, when the selected model ultimately fails (after `oneByok.maxRetries` attempts). **Disabled by default** — an empty list preserves the original behaviour. Each entry is a model id exactly as it appears in the model picker, optionally suffixed with `@ <endpoint host or name>` when several endpoints expose the same id (e.g. `"qwen3-coder @ ollama.local"`). Fallback is only attempted **before any output has been streamed**: once a reply has started, switching models would duplicate the answer and could run a tool call twice, so the request fails instead. Models must be reachable on one of the endpoints in `oneByok.endpoints`. When a fallback is used you get a warning message naming the model that answered.

name.title: Name
name.description: A display name for this endpoint (e.g. "My Ollama").

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL, ending with /v1.

commands.title: One-BYOK: Show Workspace Context
commands.description: Display the workspace context that will be injected into model prompts.

commands.title: One-BYOK: Add Endpoint
commands.description: Add another OpenAI-compatible endpoint (base URL + API key).
